scope: Revision-2 comparative Gazebo 5c-2 basket-entry redesign after three retained revision-1 unloaded failures; no absolute physical-capacity claim and no 5c-3/5d

revision_1_evidence.outcome: all three preload-0 pilots passed the nip but were rejected by the first retention feature
changes: one-way flap mass 80->25 g and damping 0.15->0.005 Nms/rad
lip 16->10 mm plus short ramp rise to Z70 mm

transferred_features: hood clearance referenced to basket floor
front retention independent of low floor feed path

variants.high_hood: smooth approximately 30-37 degree controlled-rise profile X352/Z23.5 to X250/Z90, covered high entry, roof clear plane about Z160-178 mm
variants.one_way_flap: 25 g top-hinged 96x85x2 mm flap, 0..80 degree inward-only range, damping 0.005 Nms/rad
variants.lip_cover: 10 mm centre lip above floor, short rise to Z70 mm, light roof/cheeks; low floor-to-launch feed remains open behind the lip

delivery_matrix.preload_method: dynamic fall from identical deterministic low-discrepancy release points in the common unobstructed open-top region; no final grid placement

ranking_rule: Rank by fully passing conditions, delivery successes, fewer preload-spill runs, entrance-blocked runs, then motion losses; report every condition.
physics_limitations: Incoming ground/flywheel contact retains calibrated tennis_ball_compliant.
Basket/entry/ball-to-ball contacts are uncalibrated native DART rigid contact; only relative comparison is claimed.
Flap mass, damping and hinge friction are assumptions.
Absolute capacity and rebound retention require the 1:1 physical mock-up.
